title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

  • MAVI is building a high-performance global finance network — embedding senior accounting leaders across LATAM directly into US leadership teams.
  • We are hiring experienced US Accounting Managers who are ready to operate as trusted finance partners to US CFOs and Controllers — owning close cycles, financial reporting, and operational excellence.


The Opportunity

You will serve as a direct extension of a US finance team, leading month-end close and overseeing reporting accuracy for high-growth and mid-market US companies.

This role is designed for senior professionals who want:

  • Direct collaboration with US leadership
  • High ownership and accountability
  • Exposure to global accounting standards
  • Long-term strategic partnership


What You Will Own

  • Lead and manage full month-end close under US GAAP
  • Oversee journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting packages
  • Ensure financial statements are accurate and timely
  • Supervise and guide accounting team members
  • Interface directly with US Controllers and CFOs
  • Strengthen reporting frameworks and internal controls
  • Drive process improvements and operational efficiency


What We’re Looking For

  • 6–8+ years of US GAAP accounting experience
  • Demonstrated leadership of close cycles
  • Experience managing or mentoring accounting teams
  • Strong financial reporting and GL expertise
  • Experience working directly with US stakeholders
  • ERP exposure (NetSuite preferred)
  • Strong professional English communication


Why Join MAVI

  • Operate at the same standard as US-based finance teams
  • Gain direct visibility with US leadership
  • Work on sophisticated, scaling businesses
  • Be part of a curated global network of senior accounting professionals


This Role Is Ideal For

  • Senior accounting leaders in LATAM who want more than transactional accounting — and are ready to operate as strategic finance partners within US organizations.

title: Demand Planning Analyst Americas
description:
About us:

Archroma is a globally recognized leader in specialty chemicals, dedicated to creating a more colorful, sustainable, and efficient world. Our mission is to be the best partner for our customers, with a strong commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainability. With a rich heritage of more than 100 years, we continue to drive excellence in the chemical industry. As we expand our operations, we are seeking a qualified and dedicated professional in the technical commercial area of Paper to join our team.


Position Overview

Lead the regional Demand Planning process with strong focus on forecast accuracy, BIAS reduction, volume consolidation and adherence to global Supply Chain standards. Ensure the accurate, timely and consistent upload, validation and maintenance of demand data in APO/SAP. Act as the regional focal point for demand performance, statistical insights and continuous improvement of forecasting processes.


Key Responsibilities

  • Consolidate and validate demand forecasts using historical data, trends, seasonality and structured internal inputs.
  • Improve planning KPIs such as Forecast Accuracy and BIAS through disciplined analytics and monitoring.
  • Monitor significant changes in volume patterns and adjust the demand plan accordingly in APO/SAP.
  • Ensure high data quality, consistency and timely updates following the global planning calendar.
  • Perform historical volume analysis and identify patterns or anomalies.
  • Provide analytical support for monthly S&OP cycles, including KPI reviews and performance dashboards.
  • Collaborate actively with Supply Planning, Scheduling and Global Demand Planning to ensure a feasible and aligned demand plan.
  • Participate in S&OE/S&OP routines to support scenario analysis and capacity alignment.
  • Support segmentation of SKUs based on planning criticality, service level targets and inventory strategies.
  • Recommend top-down or bottom-up demand adjustments when required to reflect true demand signals or supply constraints.


Required Competencies

  • Strong analytical and data management capabilities.
  • Advanced Excel skills; experience with APO/SAP or similar planning tools.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Advanced English; intermediate Spanish preferred.
  • Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Economics or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain or related fields.

title: Email Graphic Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design
  • Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations
  • Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience
  • Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members


Responsibilities

  • Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines
  • Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices
  • Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life
  • Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results
  • Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account
  • Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production
  • Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices
  • Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations
  • Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches
  • Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards
  • Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics


Requirements

  • 2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems
  • Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy
  • Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality
  • Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing


Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze)
  • Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement
  • Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels
  • Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement


Compensation And Benefits

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Atuará garantindo a qualidade, rastreabilidade e organização das informações necessárias para a elaboração e submissão do dossiê regulatório, conforme os prazos do pipeline de biotecnologia.

  • Registrar métodos, materiais, equipamentos e resultados em planilhas, formulários e sistemas, assegurando rastreabilidade e integridade dos dados experimentais.
  • Apoiar o time de Supply Chain no monitoramento das entregas e qualidade do material coletado em campo para ensaios regulatórios.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de protocolos agronômicos e regulatórios aplicáveis aos ensaios com cana-de-açúcar geneticamente modificada.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares envolvidas no pipeline de biotecnologia.


Formação

  • Graduação em Agronomia ou Biologia.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência com manejo agronômico de culturas (cana-de-açúcar ou milho).
  • Experiência com experimentação em campo envolvendo OGM.
  • Conhecimento de manejo agronômico e condução de ensaios agrícolas.
  • Carteira de habilitação válida e disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Conhecimento intermediário com Pacote Office (Excel / Word / Power Point)


Desejáveis

  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas operacionais (SAP e/ou LIMS).
  • Experiência prévia em ensaios regulatórios ou biossegurança aplicada a OGM.


Competências comportamentais esperadas

  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade a atividades de campo.
  • Disposição para aprendizado técnico contínuo.
  • Resiliência e organização em rotinas experimentais.
  • Perfil analítico.

  • Please prioritize senior-level Data/MLOps Engineers with strong coding ability and clear communication. Candidates must be able to clearly explain their approach, design decisions, trade offs, and alternatives, and articulate end-to-end MLOps architecture. Candidates with average coding skills or limited ability to communicate ideas will not be considered.


Data Engineer (MLOps Focus)Team & Scope

  • The team owns the entire data pipeline , from ingestion to downstream consumption.
  • Data Engineering and MLOps responsibilities are combined , and the team supports multiple projects simultaneously.
  • This is primarily a Data Engineering role , with strong exposure to MLOps and ML integration .

Technical Focus

  • The team writes significantly less SQL compared to a typical Data Engineering team.
  • There is a large Business Analyst team responsible for providing raw data and writing most of the SQL.
  • Candidates must be comfortable with SQL , but in day to day work, SQL usage is limited.
  • Strong programming and system design skills are critical, similar to a traditional Software Engineering role.
  • Python is the main programming language, but strong experience in Java or Scala is also acceptable.
  • The ideal profile is a generalist , not a specialist.
  • Key expectations include:
  • Writing production grade code
  • Designing scalable systems
  • Orchestrating end to end data and ML pipelines
  • Integrating ML models into broader systems
  • SQL is considered an additional skill , not the core focus.

title: Senior Data Modeler
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking a Senior Data Modeler / Data Architect to lead the design, governance, and evolution of our enterprise data ecosystem with a primary focus on Databricks . This role establishes data modelling and architecture standards, drives platform modernization, and partners with business and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high‐quality data solutions. Experience with other modern data platforms is a plus.


Primary Responsibilities

Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Development

  • Develop and maintain subject area models, business data models, and dimensional models (fact and dimension tables) and Semantic layer design for BI and AI solutions.
  • Define and document entities, attributes, and business definitions; resolve conflicts in terminology and meaning.
  • Build and maintain enterprise semantic layers to support analytics, BI, and AI use cases.
  • Support standardization of facts, dimensions, and shared business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable, cost‐optimized, and reliable data architectures in cloud environments.

Data Governance, Quality & Metadata

Ensure strong data governance, security, lineage, and compliance across platforms.

  • Perform data quality assessments and identify appropriate data sources in partnership with Business/Data Analysts.
  • Maintain metadata in the enterprise repository and ensure alignment with governance standards.
  • Assist in developing source‐to‐target mappings and validating data transformations.

Enterprise Architecture & Data Platform Leadership

  • Understand data architecture across Lakehouse, Warehouse, and streaming environments.
  • Involved in designing and implementing modern data platforms in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience in designing and maintaining Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
  • Involved in solution design and best practices for Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Conduct user interviews, requirements sessions, and data analysis reviews.
  • Provide architectural oversight and review solution designs across engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts to ensure consistent adoption of architectural standards.
  • Partner with cross‐functional teams to align data solutions with business needs.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in data modelling, and data architecture or data engineering.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related filed.
  • Strong background in data modeling: dimensional, 3NF, and data vault.
  • Hands on experience using data modelling tools i.e., dbt, SQLMesh, Unity Catalog, etc.
  • Hands‐on expertise with Databricks and building and maintaining medallion architecture.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security, lineage, and metadata management.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, BI, product, and business teams while influencing technical direction by developing conceptual, logical, semantic, and physical data models.
  • Ability to lead data modelling reviews and mentor engineering teams.
  • Understanding of Spark, SQL, Python, Kafka, Fivetran, APIs, and modern data pipeline frameworks. Knwodge of BI/Analytics/AI tools i.e., Power BI, ML Flow, Sagemaker, Etc.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences. Ability to influence technical, business, and executive audiences.

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Superbac é referência em soluções biotecnológicas sustentáveis, com atuação nos setores de agronegócio, saneamento, meio ambiente e indústria. Reconhecida por seu compromisso com a inovação e o desenvolvimento de produtos de base biológica, a empresa se destaca pelo uso de tecnologia de ponta e por contribuir ativamente com práticas sustentáveis no Brasil e no mundo.

Se você tem perfil analítico, gosta de desafios científicos aplicados à realidade e quer atuar em uma empresa de biotecnologia em expansão, essa vaga é para você!


Formação Acadêmica:


Doutorado em Ciências Biológicas, Biotecnologia, Biologia Molecular, Bioquímica.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Projeto: Produção de metabólito microbiano e formulação de produto microbiológico com potencial agrícola.


Principais Atividades:

  • Atividades de rotina para manutenção e organização do laboratório
  • Cultivo de bactérias em escala de bancada, desenvolvendo e validando meios de cultura e condições de fermentação focados na produção de metabólitos de interesse.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e auxiliar no desenvolvimento da formulação de MVPs para testes em casa de vegetação.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e auxiliar na seleção das formulações mais promissoras para validação em campo.
  • Participação em reuniões de planejamento e acompanhamento do projeto;
  • Elaboração de relatórios técnicos e apresentações com o progresso e os principais resultados obtidos;
  • Contribuir diretamente para a entrega de um produto em nível de maturidade tecnológica TRL6, pronto para transferência de tecnologia para produção industrial.


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Técnicas analíticas avançadas de microbiologia e bioquímica.
  • Análises de metabólitos microbianos, cultivo de microrganismos, processos fermentativos.
  • Conhecimento em delineamentos experimentais (DoE) e estatística.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico em experimentos agronômicos em casa-de-vegetação.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com biorreatores de bancada, conhecimento ou experiência na área de desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos.

Formato de trabalho : Presencial

title: ESPECIALISTA DE RECURSOS HUMANOS - GLOBAL MOBILITY
description:
QUEM SOMOS?


Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.


PLURAL


Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

Responsabilidades e atribuições



O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?


Atuar de maneira consultiva e como liderança técnica para transferências internacionais, expatriações, localizações e repatriações, considerando:

Planejamento:

  • Desenvolver estratégias alinhadas aos objetivos da empresa, elaborar processos robustos e garantir sua execução;
  • Planejar e monitorar o orçamento anual para os movimentos globais.

Gestão do Processo:

  • Envolver Parceiros de Negócio, Liderança e Fornecedores para garantir um processo personalizado, adequado às necessidades da pessoa movimentada e às Políticas de movimentação;
  • Liderar a agenda de movimentação, pensando em todo seu planejamento e aspectos financeiros, logísticos e documentação, alocação, preparação intercultural, questões trabalhistas, tributárias, previdenciárias, migratórias, onboarding, metas e objetivos, acompanhamento, carreira e retorno ou novo movimento (quando aplicável);
  • Garantir que a empresa e pessoas movimentadas estejam em conformidade com todas as regulamentações locais e internacionais;
  • Avaliar fornecedores, mantendo um relacionamento saudável, identificando e propondo oportunidades no produto/serviço.

Análise e Relatórios:

  • Coletar e analisar dados como custos, eficácia e tendências;
  • Preparar relatórios destacando o impacto da mobilidade global nos objetivos da empresa e fazendo recomendações.

Projetos:

  • Atuar em projetos da área, com foco na experiência das pessoas, simplificação/harmonização, melhoria contínua dos processos e sua automação/digitalização.


QUEM NOS INSPIRA?


  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?


  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência sólida em Global Mobility;
  • Vivência em gestão de expatriados e processos correlatos (vistos, tax compliance, benefícios internacionais);
  • Inglês fluente (comunicação diária em inglês);
  • Desejável conhecimento em plataformas de gerenciamento de mobilidade (desejável Workia);
  • Experiência com fornecedores globais e entendimento de processos internacionais de RH será um diferencial.


Informações adicionais

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental – A Wellz, oferece sessões de terapia online subsidiadas pela Suzano de forma confidencial, além de várias oportunidades de auto cuidado como jornadas, diário de humor, terapia em grupo, entre outros;
  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on-line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.

#VemSerSuzano #PlantamosOCuidado #OrgulhoEmPertencer

MUITO PRAZER, NÓS SOMOS A SUZANO!

Somos uma empresa multinacional brasileira, referência global no desenvolvimento de soluções sustentáveis e inovadoras , de origem renovável, por meio do plantio de árvores de eucalipto. E elas estão no centro do nosso propósito, que é o de “renovar a vida a partir da árvore”. É assim que nós plantamos um futuro mais sustentável para o planeta e para as pessoas .

Temos 100 anos de vida, e hoje, somos a maior fabricante de celulose do mundo e uma das maiores produtoras de papéis da América Latina . Nossos produtos atendem mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do planeta e nós exportamos para mais de 100 países. Quanto às unidades, entre administrativas e operacionais, estamos presentes também internacionalmente na Argentina, Áustria, Canadá, China, Estados Unidos, Finlândia, Israel e Suíça.

E, tudo isso só é possível por causa das pessoas da Suzano: somos a soma de cerca de 20 mil colaboradores(as) próprios(as) e mais de 20 mil terceiros e terceiras, além de 300 colaboradores(as) em nossos escritórios internacionais . Trabalhamos para ser uma empresa competitiva e protagonista na transformação da nossa cadeia de valor e da sociedade.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Senior Data Modeler
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking a Senior Data Modeler / Data Architect to lead the design, governance, and evolution of our enterprise data ecosystem with a primary focus on Databricks . This role establishes data modelling and architecture standards, drives platform modernization, and partners with business and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high‐quality data solutions. Experience with other modern data platforms is a plus.


Primary Responsibilities

Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Development

  • Develop and maintain subject area models, business data models, and dimensional models (fact and dimension tables) and Semantic layer design for BI and AI solutions.
  • Define and document entities, attributes, and business definitions; resolve conflicts in terminology and meaning.
  • Build and maintain enterprise semantic layers to support analytics, BI, and AI use cases.
  • Support standardization of facts, dimensions, and shared business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable, cost‐optimized, and reliable data architectures in cloud environments.

Data Governance, Quality & Metadata

Ensure strong data governance, security, lineage, and compliance across platforms.

  • Perform data quality assessments and identify appropriate data sources in partnership with Business/Data Analysts.
  • Maintain metadata in the enterprise repository and ensure alignment with governance standards.
  • Assist in developing source‐to‐target mappings and validating data transformations.

Enterprise Architecture & Data Platform Leadership

  • Understand data architecture across Lakehouse, Warehouse, and streaming environments.
  • Involved in designing and implementing modern data platforms in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience in designing and maintaining Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
  • Involved in solution design and best practices for Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Conduct user interviews, requirements sessions, and data analysis reviews.
  • Provide architectural oversight and review solution designs across engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts to ensure consistent adoption of architectural standards.
  • Partner with cross‐functional teams to align data solutions with business needs.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in data modelling, and data architecture or data engineering.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related filed.
  • Strong background in data modeling: dimensional, 3NF, and data vault.
  • Hands on experience using data modelling tools i.e., dbt, SQLMesh, Unity Catalog, etc.
  • Hands‐on expertise with Databricks and building and maintaining medallion architecture.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security, lineage, and metadata management.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, BI, product, and business teams while influencing technical direction by developing conceptual, logical, semantic, and physical data models.
  • Ability to lead data modelling reviews and mentor engineering teams.
  • Understanding of Spark, SQL, Python, Kafka, Fivetran, APIs, and modern data pipeline frameworks. Knwodge of BI/Analytics/AI tools i.e., Power BI, ML Flow, Sagemaker, Etc.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences. Ability to influence technical, business, and executive audiences.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Accountant (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product


Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role


The Associate Staff Accountant is a key operational member of the Finance team, responsible for owning day-to-day billing and accounts receivable activities while also serving as a backup and support resource across accounts payable, procurement, and general ledger operations.

This role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, customer communication, and financial systems. The Associate Staff Accountant ensures timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and customer support, while also contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and process automation initiatives. You will work closely with the Associate Accounting Manager, Controller, and internal account managers to maintain accurate financial records and support scalable finance operations.


What You Will Do


Primary Responsibilities: Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Customer Billing Ownership: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices in accordance with contracts, pricing schedules, and billing timelines.
  • Collections Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging, proactively follow up on overdue invoices, and manage customer communications to drive timely payment.
  • Cash Application: Apply customer payments accurately and promptly; research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, and discrepancies.
  • Billing Disputes & Resolution: Partner with customers and internal account managers to investigate and resolve billing questions, disputes, and adjustments.
  • Customer Support: Serve as a primary finance contact for billing and payment inquiries, delivering clear, professional, and timely responses.


Reporting, Analysis & Cross-Functional Support

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.


Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.


General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).


What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Técnico(a) Instrumentação III
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência


Desafios


Liderar e executar atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, calibração, configuração e análise de falhas em instrumentos de medição, controle e automação nas áreas de Recuperação (caldeiras de recuperação, evaporadores, tratamento de gases) e Utilidades (caldeiras de força, turbinas, sistemas de tratamento de água, ar comprimido, vapor, gaseificação), atuando como referência técnica, desenvolvendo soluções avançadas, liderando equipes em intervenções complexas, garantindo a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança dos sistemas de instrumentação, seguindo planos, procedimentos e normas de segurança.


Principais Atividades


  • Atuação em manutenção preventiva e corretiva de instrumentos críticos, incluindo analisadores de gases e água, transmissores inteligentes, válvulas de controle, atuadores e sistemas de segurança (ESD e interlocks).
  • Diagnóstico e solução de falhas complexas com uso de ferramentas avançadas, análise de diagramas técnicos e históricos de falhas.
  • Execução de calibração, ajustes de alta precisão e parametrizações avançadas (HART, Fieldbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP).
  • Análise e otimização de malhas de controle complexas, como PID em cascata, controle preditivo e multivariável.
  • Liderança técnica em projetos de melhoria, comissionamento e testes de novos sistemas.
  • Elaboração de relatórios técnicos, registros em CMMS e análise de dados para melhoria contínua da manutenção.
  • Desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, com treinamento, mentoria e avaliação de profissionais de instrumentação.
  • Atuação rigorosa em segurança, meio ambiente, qualidade, ética e compliance.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Técnico em Instrumentação, Automação Industrial, Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Integração Segurança;
  • Ferramentas da qualidade;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office e SAP;
  • Conhecimento avançado em instrumentação industrial (tipos de instrumentos de medição, transmissores analógicos e digitais, válvulas de controle, atuadores, posicionadores, sistemas de segurança);
  • Expertise Leitura e interpretação avançada de diagramas de instrumentação detalhados (malhas de controle complexas, diagramas lógicos, fiação e interligação);
  • Calibração de instrumentos de pressão, temperatura, vazão, nível e analisadores;
  • Configuração e parametrização de instrumentos inteligentes (HART, Fieldbus, Profibus) e sistemas de comunicação industrial;
  • Sistemas de controle (CLP, SDCD - programação básica, troubleshooting avançado, arquitetura de sistemas);
  • Normas de segurança do trabalho (NR-10) e normas técnicas de instrumentação;
  • CNH – Categoria “B”
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Inocência/MS
  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol, será um diferencial.


Se esse desafio conversa com a sua trajetória, este é o momento. Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do Projeto Sucuriú — a grandeza que abraça.

  • CloudFormation.

  • Ferramentas de CDC: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CDC, entendo os tradeoffs entre as

  • Deploy de Modelos de Machine Learning: Experiência avançada no deploy e monitoramento de
  • modelos de machine learning.
  • Ferramentas de ETL e Orquestração: Expertise com Apache Airflow, dbt, e outras ferramentas de ETL.
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência avançada em Python e SQL.

  • garantir a acessibilidade e qualidade dos dados.

title: Diretor de Experiência do Cliente no Varejo
description:
Somos uma startup de IA criada para o varejo - e estamos procurando profissionais de varejo.


A STOREE.AI é uma startup em crescimento que leva IA para lojas físicas de forma prática e pé no chão.


Ajudamos organizações de varejo a conduzirem melhor as operações do dia a dia - comunicação, tarefas, prioridades, acompanhamentos e KPIs - usando uma IA que funciona como um ótimo gestor.


Você não precisa ter background técnico.

Sem experiência com software. Sem conhecimento em IA.


Se você entende como o varejo realmente funciona - pessoas, pressão, execução e tomada de decisão - você já tem exatamente o que buscamos.


Nós construímos a tecnologia.

Você traz a experiência de varejo.


Essa é a parceria.


O que fazemos:


A STOREE.AI é usada diariamente por mais de 100 redes de lojas no mundo.


A plataforma fica no centro das operações da loja e ajuda gestores a:


  • Comunicar com clareza com lojas e equipes
  • Transformar prioridades em tarefas executáveis
  • Fazer follow-up de forma automática e consistente
  • Acompanhar performance e KPIs em tempo real
  • Treinar e orientar equipes no trabalho do dia a dia, não em apresentações


Ela é familiar para quem é do varejo, porque foi construída em torno de como os bons gestores já operam - só que mais rápido, mais claro e em escala.


Por que a experiência de varejo importa:


Nossa plataforma é poderosa, mas varejo não é “tamanho único”.


O que importa para uma rede de moda não é o mesmo que importa para um supermercado.

O que um líder de VM procura é diferente do que HR/RH ou Operações procuram.


Por isso, não estamos buscando vendedores tradicionais.


Estamos buscando profissionais seniores de varejo que consigam:


  • Entender as necessidades reais de uma organização de varejo
  • Ajudar a moldar o “gestor de IA” certo para cada rede
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não buzzwords
  • Conduzir conversas com credibilidade e profundidade


Isso é desenvolvimento de negócios baseado em entendimento, não em “pitch”.


O que você vai fazer na prática:


  • Construir relacionamentos com organizações de varejo relevantes
  • Iniciar conversas usando nossas ferramentas de IA (treinamento completo incluído)
  • Mostrar como a STOREE.AI se encaixa na realidade específica deles
  • Conduzir o processo ou passar para nosso time central quando necessário
  • Influenciar a direção do produto - você será nosso olhar de varejo dentro da empresa


Você não vai “vender software”.

Você vai conectar experiência com soluções reais.


Para quem é:


Líderes seniores de varejo, incluindo:


  • Gerentes de loja, distrito e regional
  • Líderes de HQ em operações, RH, treinamento, VM, CX ou excelência no varejo
  • Qualquer pessoa que já liderou equipes de varejo e quer dar o próximo passo


Se você já pensou:


“A tecnologia não entende de verdade o que acontece nas lojas” - nós concordamos.


Foi exatamente por isso que criamos a STOREE.AI.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessário background técnico
  • Trabalho remoto com horários flexíveis
  • Remuneração por comissão, com possibilidade de efetivação full-time
  • Chance de entrar antes de uma grande escala global
  • Tecnologia real, já funcionando no campo


Isso não é um emprego.


É uma segunda carreira.


De comandar lojas para ajudar a definir como as lojas serão comandadas.


Quer começar direto? Inicie o processo aqui.

title: Engenheiro de Software Backend IA
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora com foco em soluções de IA Generativa , que seja apaixonada por arquiteturas escaláveis, automações e inteligência conversacional. Buscamos alguém com domínio de Python e experiência prática com soluções modernas de IA aplicadas ao mercado real — especialmente com agentes autônomos, RAG e integrações em nuvem.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter backends orientados a modelos de linguagem , utilizando LangChain , RAG e arquiteturas baseadas em agentes (multi-agent systems);
  • Construir e orquestrar fluxos com filas (SQS) para garantir escalabilidade e processamento assíncrono;

Qualificações obrigatórias:

  • Domínio de Python ;
  • Experiência prática com LangChain e/ou frameworks similares de orquestração de LLMs;
  • Conhecimento sobre RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e integração com vetores;
  • Experiência com AWS , especialmente SQS , Lambda, DynamoDB e S3;
  • Vivência em arquiteturas com agentes autônomos (multi-agents) ;
  • Familiaridade com consumo de APIs de LLMs (como OpenAI);
  • Capacidade de documentar, testar e manter código escalável e sustentável;
  • Conhecimento sólido em bibliotecas de IA como TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, e similares;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e integração de chatbots.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com MLOps ou deploy de modelos em produção;
  • Conhecimentos em bancos vetoriais como Pinecone , FAISS ou Weaviate ;
  • Noções de arquitetura de microsserviços e mensageria distribuída.


Benefícios:

What makes us different?

title: Enterprise Account Manager — HR Technology (LATAM)
description:
About Cadient


Cadient Talent is an AI-enabled hiring platform helping large employers attract, hire, and retain hourly and distributed workforces at scale. Our platform combines ATS technology, automation, and AI-driven recruiting workflows to help organizations:

  • Reduce time-to-hire
  • Increase applicant conversion
  • Improve hiring outcomes for high-volume workforces


Cadient serves enterprise employers across industries including healthcare, hospitality, retail, and service businesses. We are building the next generation of AI-powered hiring infrastructure used by some of the largest hiring organizations in the United States.


The Role

We are hiring an Enterprise Account Manager based in Latin America to manage and grow relationships with US-based enterprise clients. You will act as the primary relationship owner for HR and Talent Acquisition leaders, ensuring they achieve measurable hiring results using the Cadient platform. This role is responsible for client retention, revenue expansion, and strategic account management. You will operate as a trusted advisor, helping clients optimize hiring performance while identifying opportunities to expand their use of Cadient solutions.


Key Responsibilities


Own Client Relationships

  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise customer accounts in the United States
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for HR and talent acquisition leaders
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) analyzing hiring performance and platform usage
  • Ensure strong platform adoption, satisfaction, and measurable outcomes
  • Monitor client health signals and proactively resolve risks


Drive Revenue Expansion

  • Identify opportunities to expand platform usage and services
  • Drive renewals, upsells, and cross-sells
  • Build expansion pipelines within existing accounts
  • Work closely with sales leadership on strategic account growth


Coordinate Across Teams

  • Partner with product, support, and implementation teams
  • Ensure issues are resolved quickly and professionally
  • Bring customer insights back to internal teams to improve product and service delivery


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 3–6 years experience in account management, customer success, or SaaS client management
  • Experience working with US-based customers
  • Fluent English communication skills
  • Strong ability to manage multiple client relationships simultaneously
  • Comfortable discussing business outcomes, ROI, and performance metrics
  • Experience working remotely across US time zones


Preferred

  • Experience in HR technology, SaaS, or recruiting platforms
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Workday, iCIMS, UKG, Paradox, or similar
  • Experience working with enterprise HR or talent acquisition teams
  • Experience supporting high-volume hiring industries
  • Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.


What Success Looks Like

  • High client retention and Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Strong platform adoption and client satisfaction
  • Consistent upsell and expansion opportunities
  • Clear communication of account risks and opportunities
  • Strong internal collaboration with sales, product, and support teams


What You'll Be Responsible For in the First 90 Days

  • Build relationships with 20–40 active US client accounts
  • Conduct your first client performance and strategy reviews
  • Identify 3–5 expansion opportunities within existing accounts
  • Develop strong working relationships with internal product and support teams
  • Gain deep familiarity with Cadient’s hiring platform and workflows


This Role Is NOT a Fit If

  • You are looking for an entry-level customer support role
  • You are uncomfortable owning revenue retention and upsells
  • You prefer task execution instead of client-facing strategy
  • You are not comfortable speaking directly with US enterprise clients in English


Why Join Cadient

  • Work with a growing HR technology company serving large US employers
  • Be part of the AI transformation of hiring
  • Fully remote role based in Latin America
  • Exposure to enterprise HR leaders and large-scale hiring operations
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based upside


Application Note

When applying, please include a short paragraph answering the following question:

What is one thing most SaaS companies do wrong in customer success?


Applications without this answer may not be considered!

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node Senior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esperamos um profissional com vivência em testes e documentação de APIs, garantindo qualidade, organização e clareza nas entregas técnicas.

Valorizamos um perfil autônomo, colaborativo e comprometido com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, que contribua ativamente para a evolução das soluções e do time.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Matrix IFS is looking for a Data Scientist, the job involves working with client data to develop and implement fraud detection models, which includes data cleaning, feature engineering, and model tuning. Responsibilities also include collaborating with clients and internal teams, communicating findings, and contributing to product development by creating scalable data pipelines and improving processes.

Key skills required are proficiency in Python (including libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn), machine learning, distributed computing (like PySpark), and strong communication abilities.

Core responsibilities

  • Technical leadership: Provide technical guidance, drive project execution, and contribute to building scalable data pipelines and prototypes.
  • Product development: Help improve the product by contributing to solution development, keeping up with fraud prevention trends, and creating generalized product enhancements.
  • Communication: Clearly communicate complex findings and strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key skills and qualifications

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python, including scientific stack libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn) and experience with distributed computing tools like PySpark.
  • Machine Learning: Expertise in machine learning concepts and algorithms.
  • Data Manipulation: Experience with data cleaning, feature engineering, and building scalable data pipelines (e.g., with Airflow and Trino).
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex ideas to various stakeholders.
  • Analytical: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex financial crime challenges.

Education: A degree in a quantitative field like Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related area is often required.

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.
