Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de Braço do Norte - SC


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

description:

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams

Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Experience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives

Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems

Job Description


Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.

Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Assegurar o recebimento das informações das áreas envolvidas e apoiar na execução dos pagamentos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, minimizando impactos de multas e juros.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas e prazos, realizando integração de informações via ERP e processos manuais, garantindo a validação por meio de checklists e controles internos.
  • Executar fluxo de pagamentos a fornecedores e adiantamentos a colaboradores, realizando conciliações bancárias e de caixa equivalente.
  • Apoiar e acompanhar o controle dos fluxos de pagamento, validações e conciliações realizadas por assistentes e analistas juniores.

  • Executar rotinas de fechamento mensal da área de Contas a Pagar, garantindo a correta formalização de documentos, controles internos e atendimento às auditorias interna e externa.
  • Controlar e realizar baixa de operações cambiais relacionadas a pagamentos internacionais, validando informações enviadas pela tesouraria e garantindo atualização sistêmica dos efeitos cambiais.
  • Executar controle de operações de risco sacado e confirming, realizando envio de dados bancários, controle e validação de arquivos de remessa e retorno, além de prestar suporte às áreas internas e fornecedores.
  • Identificar e tratar inconsistências, analisando causa raiz e propondo melhorias nos processos.
  • Orientar áreas internas sobre fluxos e procedimentos de contas a pagar, contribuindo para melhoria contínua e compliance das operações financeiras.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.


Conhecimentos técnicos:


  • Conhecimento básico em rotinas de Contas a Pagar.
  • Noções de conciliação bancária e fluxo de caixa.
  • Conhecimento em fechamento mensal e controles financeiros.
  • Noções de operações cambiais e pagamentos internacionais (diferencial).

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.

This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering

Experience level

title: Consultor(a) de Relacionamento_Curitiba (PR)
description:

A Juntos Somos Mais é uma startup de tecnologia atuando no mercado da construção civil desde 2018 que tem como acionistas três gigantes do mercado: Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre.

  • Tirar dúvidas sobre campanhas, regras e funcionalidades;
  • Apoiar as indústrias e distribuidores parceiros localmente, sendo um ponto de contato estratégico e confiável;
  • Trazer feedbacks e insights valiosos do campo para apoiar o time de produto, marketing e operações;
  • Colaborar com times internos na ativação de novos sellers do marketplace;
  • Monitorar tendências do varejo e concorrência na região;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com donos, gerentes e vendedores — somos uma marca próxima e presente!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em área comercial (presencial);
  • Boa comunicação e escuta ativa — você vai lidar com muitos perfis diferentes;
  • Organização para lidar com uma carteira diversa e realizar visitas diárias;
  • Interesse genuíno em aprender sobre o setor de material de construção (experiência prévia é um plus!);
  • Perfil mão na massa, que resolve, propõe e faz acontecer;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens dentro da região;
  • Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído (Administração, Marketing, Comércio Exterior ou áreas afins);
  • CNH válida e Excel no mínimo intermediário.


O que pode te destacar:

  • Conhecimento prévio em marketplace B2B;
  • Ter atuado com rotina externa e visitas diárias;
  • Ter facilidade para apresentar, treinar e engajar clientes.


Por que vale a pena:

Você vai trabalhar em um programa que conecta varejo, indústria e tecnologia para transformar um dos setores mais importantes do país — e fazer isso com autonomia, responsabilidade e muita troca. Aqui, a gente valoriza quem constrói junto, compartilha aprendizados e busca soluções com propósito.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.


Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users.   • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

description:

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal. Somos corajosos e empreendedores.

Deverá atuar garantindo que todas as atividades estejam em conformidade com os requisitos de custo, segurança, meio ambiente, produção e manutenção, contribuindo diretamente para o alcance das metas de disponibilidade física e confiabilidade dos equipamentos e instalações.

Além disso, espera-se experiência em Planejamento, Aprovisionamento, Programação e Controle de Manutenção Industrial e/ou de frota, planejamento de grandes paradas e gestão de indicadores (KPIs) de manutenção.

description:

With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably.   • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js / RoR)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails to join the core development team of our U.S. client. You will design, build, and deliver the best financial software on the planet!


Our client is a fintech company that provides commodities managers with task automation and timely insights on their trades, including risk exposure, positions, and profits and losses. With over 5 million trades on its SaaS platform, the company is an award-winning industry leader that counts some of the world's largest financial firms as customers. Our client is growing rapidly and is looking for smart, bold risk-takers to further its product strategy of market disruption and expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and test new features for the clients next-gen trading platform
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and reusable code
  • Utilize AI tooling, such as Cursor and CodeRabbit, to accelerate software development
  • Participate in and support the full continuous testing and delivery pipeline
  • Join the engineering support rotation, assisting the Customer Success team
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and feature tests
  • Review code and tests written by other team members
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt
  • Accept, act on, and provide feedback in a timely manner
  • Seek and provide timely technical assistance and clarification.
  • Collaborate with and mentor team members
  • Learn new technologies (and help your teammates learn them too)
  • Support the clients growth by contributing to open-source projects and representing the client within the developer community


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 3+ years of experience developing full stack applications with React.js and Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with TypeScript, SQL-compliant databases, Go, Python, or other open-source and commercial technologies, such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
  • Proficient in the use of AI tooling such as Cursor and GitHub CoPilot
  • Experience with high-volume, event-based system architectures and Agile software development practices
  • A self-disciplined, task-oriented approach to development, testing, and code structure
  • Desire to work in an environment that:
  • Embraces diversity
  • Maintains a client-centric approach to building products
  • Strives to maintain a world-class organization
  • Loves technology
  • Gives back to the community
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and bring order from chaos
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.

Preferred Experience

  • University degree in Computer Science, a related field of study, or equivalent experience

title: AI Video Editor
description:
Hiring: AI Video Editor / Performance Videographer

Company: Rain Media

Reports to: Creative Director

Status: Full-time Contractor (Global)

Location: Argentina and Brazil, preferred


Position Overview

Are You a Performance-Driven Video Editor Who Knows How to Turn Creative Into Conversions? If you think in hooks, pacing, and paid social performance, and you’re already leveraging AI video tools to produce faster, smarter creative, this role is for you.

At Organics Ocean, we’re looking for an AI-native Video Editor / Performance Videographer who will help scale high-volume direct response creative. This role exists to solve a key business need: increasing creative output, improving execution speed, and reducing revision cycles while elevating the quality of edits through advanced AI workflows.

This is a production-first role focused primarily on editing, post-production, and AI-enhanced creative, not traditional filming.

You will work closely with Creative, Growth, and Marketing partners to deliver performance-focused assets that directly impact campaign velocity.


Who we are: Organics Ocean

We are a premium direct-to-consumer supplement brand helping people live healthier lives through science-backed, clean, and effective products.

We’re not a company where things stay the same. We test, we optimize, we innovate—and we want someone who thrives in that kind of high-accountability, fast-paced environment.


Why join our team?


High-growth eCommerce brand: Driven by innovation and fast execution, Organics Ocean has seen 350% year over year growth.


Ownership & Accountability: We trust our team members to take full ownership of their responsibilities. You are empowered to lead, execute, and improve without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative, hold themselves accountable, and drive meaningful results.


A team of high performers: We push boundaries, move fast, and get things done. The company is in a hockey stick growth phase. This is not a good fit for those who don’t want to grow.


Responsibilities

Direct Response Video Editing

  • Produce high-quality paid social performance creatives
  • Execute UGC edits, AI creative, AI UGC, mini-VSL, and VSL formats
  • Optimize pacing, hooks, and CTAs for conversion
  • Deliver high output with minimal revision cycles

AI Video Workflow Integration

  • Use AI tools to accelerate production and improve quality
  • Create both AI-forward and AI-assisted realistic creatives
  • Continuously test new AI workflows to improve performance

Creative Collaboration

  • Partner with Creative Strategy to execute briefs
  • Attend creative meetings to reduce revision loops
  • Align closely with Creative leadership on feedback

Production & Workflow Support

  • Act as a point of contact between Creative Lead and external editors
  • Help disseminate process updates and feedback to contractors
  • Support operational efficiency and creative throughput

Filming (Secondary Responsibility)

  • Occasional product shots or B-roll when needed


What success looks like


First 90 Days

  • Fully ramp into Rain Media’s performance creative workflow and AI editing stack
  • Deliver consistent weekly output aligned to creative briefs and paid social requirements
  • Demonstrate proficiency using required AI tools within real production workflows
  • Reduce revision cycles by actively participating in creative meetings and feedback loops
  • Establish clear collaboration rhythms with Creative leadership and external editors
  • Begin contributing process improvements that increase speed and execution quality

In 12 months:

  • Consistently deliver 15–20 high-performing creatives per week with strong execution speed
  • Become a key leverage point for creative production, supporting communication with external editors and improving workflow efficiency
  • Elevate overall creative quality through advanced AI integration and experimentation
  • Maintain a standard of ≤1 revision cycle between strategy and editing whenever possible
  • Help scale creative volume without sacrificing performance or brand quality
  • Contribute to evolving Rain Media’s AI-first creative production framework


Requirements

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies to Excel in This Role)

  • Ability to communicate (speak/write) fluent English
  • 2 + yrs proven experience editing direct response performance creatives for paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
  • Must have AI video experience and samples to showcase your work
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused editing, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, and call-to-action structure
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-volume creative output in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment
  • Hands-on experience using AI video generation and enhancement tools within production workflows
  • Proficiency with core editing platforms such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of creative design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Figma
  • Experience collaborating closely with creative strategists, growth teams, or performance marketing teams
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and execute with minimal revision cycles
  • Strong communication skills and comfort participating in real-time feedback sessions
  • Ability to manage multiple creative experiments simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality

AI & Technical Proficiency (Required)

  • Experience working with tools such as Higgsfield, Google V3/Gemini workflows , or similar AI-driven platforms
  • Understanding of AI-assisted editing techniques, including both overt AI creative and realistic AI integrations

Nice-to-Have Proficiencies

  • Experience with advanced AI platforms such as Sora, Kling , or emerging generative video tools
  • Familiarity with open-source AI workflows or technical experimentation across AI ecosystems
  • Background supporting or coordinating external video editors or creative contractors

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work within US time zones (Eastern preferred)
  • Access to a work computer, a reliable internet connection and a distraction-free workspace
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response and AI-enhanced video work


Offer Details

Compensation: Contractor compensation will be aligned to regional market benchmarks based on the candidate’s country of residence and expressed as monthly salary ranges.


About Organics Ocean

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit the website.

The company is a place for innovation. Team roles and responsibilities are clear, and the passion for being a part of something bigger than oneself is shared by everyone. The environment is casual, but the work is serious. Riding this wave of growth only works with A-Players on the team, and that is what everyone is: an A-Player.


Cultural Pillars:

  • Accountability : Take full ownership of your responsibilities and their outcomes. You commit to seeing tasks through, accepting both successes and failures as your own, and continuously learning and improving along the way.
  • Operational Excellence: We believe a strong Foundation is a scalable business. In e-commerce, every action becomes a building block and small cracks compound quickly as we grow. We prioritize building reliable processes, systems, and standards that hold up under scale. We fix breakdowns early, design for consistency, and execute with discipline so growth doesn't introduce chaos.
  • Clarity & Trust: Clarity builds trust, and it goes both ways. Leaders are responsible for setting clear expectations, priorities, and context. Team members are responsible for asking questions, raising their hands, and seeking clarity when something is unclear. When clarity is actively given an actively sought, trust grows, decisions improve, and the teams move faster together.
  • Efficient Leverage: Efficient leverage means doing the right work, not more work. We challenge the status quo, explore better ways of working, and speak up when we see opportunities to improve. We value fresh thinking, but apply it with intention, building systems, making decisions, and creating leverage that drives meaningful impact. Through innovation paired with discipline, we pull the right levers to move the business forward and scale sustainably.
  • Move Fast and Persevere: We push forward with speed and determination, even when things get tough. In the fast-paced world of e-commerce and startups, challenges are inevitable. Success comes from acting quickly, adapting, and staying resilient when obstacles arise. We don’t slow down when things get hard—we press through and keep moving forward.

description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. description:

Título da Posição: Engenheiro(a) de Software Full Stack Sênior

Top 3 requisitos obrigatórios no currículo:

  • Forte experiência em desenvolvimento backend com atuação prática em serviços AWS.
  • Experiência comprovada no design e construção de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis.
  • Experiência Full Stack com desenvolvimento moderno de front-end (NodeJS e React).


Visão geral do processo seletivo:

  • Entrevista de Design de Sistemas com o time de engenharia, com foco em arquitetura e design de sistemas.
  • Entrevista de Resolução de Problemas com o gerente contratante e um engenheiro, para avaliar capacidade de resolução de problemas, comunicação e alinhamento com a equipe.


Descrição da Vaga

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe Autodesk Info360 está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior experiente para integrar o time. Nesta função, você ajudará a projetar, construir e escalar soluções cloud-native que impulsionam fluxos de trabalho modernos de gestão de recursos hídricos.

Esta é uma posição de alto impacto, com foco em backend e arquitetura em nuvem, mantendo também forte responsabilidade sobre experiências voltadas ao usuário.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver soluções inovadoras para gestão de recursos hídricos em fluxos de trabalho orientados a produto.
  • Projetar e construir serviços backend escaláveis e cloud-native na AWS, utilizando arquitetura híbrida entre containers e serverless.
  • Desenvolver código de qualidade para produção, testável, legível e eficiente.
  • Arquitetar e implementar processos complexos de carga e transformação de dados em alto volume e alta frequência, utilizando métodos e ferramentas ETL de ponta.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e suporte aos colegas por meio de revisões de design, code reviews e colaboração contínua.
  • Projetar e desenvolver funcionalidades voltadas ao usuário utilizando React e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento web.
  • Atuar como líder técnico(a) em iniciativas específicas de engenharia, contribuindo para decisões arquiteturais e de implementação.


Qualificações:

  • 10+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software, incluindo experiência relevante em arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Experiência comprovada no design e construção de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal, para articular ideias complexas a diferentes stakeholders.
  • Excelente capacidade analítica, de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.
  • Profunda expertise em desenvolvimento cloud-native, com experiência prática em serviços AWS como Lambda, API Gateway e DynamoDB.
  • Experiência com AWS IoT é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) — Terraform ou CloudFormation — é um diferencial.
  • 3+ anos de experiência com React e seu ecossistema.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Machine Learning é um diferencial.

title: Desenvolvedor BackEnd Sênior - JavaScript/Node + AWS (com atuação em arquitetura e refinamento de requisitos)
description:
Sobre a InBot:

Somos uma empresa especializada em Inteligência Artificial Conversacional. Desenvolvemos assistentes virtuais inteligentes que integram PLN (Processamento de Linguagem Natural), busca semântica e IA generativa, oferecendo experiências únicas para usuários e resultados práticos para nossos clientes.

Mais sobre nós:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Arquitetura e Refinamento Técnico (Discovery → Delivery): Atuar junto às áreas de negócio e ao time técnico no levantamento, análise e refinamento de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas claras (user stories, critérios de aceite, regras de negócio, fluxos e integrações) e apoiando a definição da melhor arquitetura para entrega.


Gestão Técnica do Backlog: Apoiar a organização e priorização técnica das demandas, garantindo que as atividades estejam bem detalhadas, quebradas em entregas incrementais e com dependências mapeadas, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando previsibilidade.


Definição de Solução e Padrões: Propor e documentar padrões técnicos, decisões de arquitetura (ADRs), contratos de API e boas práticas (observabilidade, versionamento, consistência de integrações, idempotência, retries, rate limit, etc.), garantindo escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.


Colaboração e Alinhamento Contínuo: Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review), contribuindo para clareza técnica, estimativas realistas e alinhamento entre produto, operações e desenvolvimento.


Qualidade e Segurança no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Reforçar práticas de code review, testes automatizados, análise estática e segurança (OWASP, gestão de segredos, IAM least privilege), garantindo qualidade do código e confiabilidade das entregas.


Uso de IA Generativa com Governança: Utilizar IA generativa para potencializar produtividade (análise de logs, geração/validação de testes, rascunho de documentação, scaffolding de código e refatorações assistidas), mantendo rigor em revisão humana, versionamento, padrões internos e práticas de segurança.


Mentoria e Multiplicação Técnica: Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time, com mentorias, revisão de PRs, suporte em decisões de design e disseminação de boas práticas para elevar o nível técnico do squad.


Desenvolvimento em Nuvem: Atuar em ambientes AWS (EC2, EKS, ECR, ACM, RDS), garantindo performance, escalabilidade e segurança.

Conteinerização e Orquestração: Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e Kubernetes (administração, criação de pods, serviços, ingress, etc.).

Integrações de Sistemas: Desenvolver integrações entre o assistente virtual e os sistemas dos clientes utilizando APIs REST e JSON, além de OpenAPI/Swagger.

Desenvolvimento Backend: Trabalhar principalmente com JavaScript, Node.js, Promises, HTML5, CSS e TypeScript para criar funcionalidades robustas e assíncronas de forma eficiente.

Autenticação e Segurança: Implementar autenticação com OIDC (OpenID Connect), SAML e aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.

Criação e Manutenção de APIs: Desenvolver APIs internas e externas com documentação clara e padronizada.

Gestão de Bancos de Dados: Criar, administrar e otimizar bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, MongoDB, RDS na AWS).

Ambiente Linux: Gerenciar e configurar servidores Linux, utilizando Shell Script para automação.

Controle de Versões: Utilizar Git para versionamento de código, integração contínua e práticas de CI/CD.

Desenvolvimento de Relatórios: Criar queries e relatórios para produtos e serviços.

Boas Práticas: Aplicar Promises, testes automatizados, documentação de código e metodologias ágeis para garantir escalabilidade e qualidade.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (filas, mensageria, processamento assíncrono) e padrões de resiliência.

Familiaridade com IA aplicada ao ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex.: geração de testes, revisão assistida, documentação automatizada) com governança e segurança.

Conhecimento em microserviços e arquitetura serverless.

Experiência com DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.

Familiaridade com IA Generativa para otimização de processos e experiência do usuário.

Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas (redes, firewalls, DNS, roteamento, modelagem de dados).

Experiência com Java ou Scala.

Desenvolvimento Full Stack: Atuar também em camadas de front-end sempre que necessário, garantindo a integração de ponta a ponta.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Mínimo 5 anos comprovados em desenvolvimento, essencialmente com JavaScript e Node.js.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Imprescindíveis:

AWS (EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, ECR, ACM, RDS)

APIs REST e JSON

Git (controle de código e versionamento)

Linux (administração e Shell)

Promises e programação assíncrona em JavaScript

Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro e testes automatizados


Soft Skills e Competências Comportamentais:

Tradução Negócio ↔ Técnica: Capacidade de entender rapidamente o contexto do cliente e transformar necessidades em soluções técnicas claras, alinhadas com prazos, riscos e impactos.


Senso de Dono e Pragmatismo: Foco em entregar valor com qualidade, escolhendo soluções sustentáveis e evitando complexidade desnecessária.


Organização e Comunicação Técnica: Saber conduzir refinamentos, registrar decisões e manter o time alinhado, garantindo transparência e clareza sobre escopo, riscos e dependências.


Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento técnico e de negócio.

Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e cumprir prazos.

Comunicação: Clareza e objetividade ao se comunicar com clientes e equipe interna.

Senso de Lógica e Criatividade: Resolver problemas de forma analítica, criando soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Informações adicionais

Contrato PJ + cartão Flash.

Projetos desafiadores e inovadores, com tecnologia de ponta em IA conversacional.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Gestor financeiro
description:
Vaga: Gestor Financeiro (Foco em Cobranças e Assinaturas)

Sobre a Pátria AgroNegócios:

Nós somos a Pátria AgroNegócios, a maior e mais influente consultoria de mercado agrícola do Brasil. Com uma base de mais de 2.400 produtores rurais e uma área de cobertura que ultrapassa 12 milhões de hectares, nossa missão é transformar informação em resultado, garantindo mais rentabilidade e segurança para quem produz. Atuamos nos mercados de soja, milho, trigo, algodão, café e boi gordo, oferecendo um serviço de assinatura que entrega análises de mercado e recomendações estratégicas diretamente para nossos clientes.


Somos a única consultoria de relevância no setor com registro na ANBIMA, e nosso crescimento é impulsionado por uma equipe de alta performance e uma cultura que valoriza a inovação, a proximidade com o cliente e, acima de tudo, a paixão pelo agronegócio brasileiro.


Descrição da Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Gestor(a) Financeiro(a) para liderar nosso setor de Cobranças, uma área vital para a sustentabilidade de nosso modelo de negócio baseado em assinaturas. O profissional será responsável por gerenciar todo o ciclo de vida da receita (order-to-cash), desde a emissão de faturas até a recuperação de créditos, garantindo a saúde financeira da empresa e a manutenção de um relacionamento positivo com nossa valiosa base de clientes.


Este é um papel estratégico que exige não apenas excelência técnica em finanças, mas também uma grande habilidade de gestão de pessoas e negociação, com o objetivo de otimizar processos, reduzir a inadimplência e maximizar a retenção de clientes.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

•       Gestão do Ciclo de Receita: Supervisionar e otimizar todo o processo de faturamento e cobrança para os diferentes planos de assinatura (mensal, trimestral, semestral e anual).

•       Estratégia de Cobrança: Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar a eficácia de réguas de cobrança automatizadas e personalizadas, visando a redução da taxa de inadimplência e do churn involuntário.

•       Liderança de Equipe: Gerenciar a equipe de cobranças, estabelecendo metas claras e acompanhando a performance individual e do time.

•       Análise e Relatórios: Monitorar e analisar os principais indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da área, como MRR (Receita Recorrente Mensal), Taxa Churn, Taxa de Inadimplência e Prazo Médio de Recebimento (PMR). Preparar relatórios gerenciais para a diretoria.

•       Negociação e Relacionamento com o Cliente: Atuar diretamente na negociação com clientes em casos de inadimplência complexa, buscando soluções amigáveis que preservem o relacionamento a longo prazo.

•       Otimização de Processos: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos e sistemas de cobrança, buscando maior eficiência operacional e automação.

•       Conformidade: Assegurar que todos os procedimentos de cobrança e faturamento estejam em conformidade com a legislação vigente.


Requisitos e Qualificações

Competências Técnicas:

Habilidade|Nível Desejado:

  • Experiência em Gestão Financeira (Avançado)
  • Gestão de Contas a Receber/Cobrança (Avançado)
  • Experiência com Modelos de Assinatura/Recorrência (SaaS) (Intermediário/Avançado)
  • Domínio de Software de Gestão Financeira/ERP (Avançado)
  • Proficiência em MS Excel (Fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas) (Avançado)
  • Análise de Dados e Criação de Relatórios Financeiros (Avançado)
  • Conhecimento de Legislação Financeira e Tributária (Intermediário)
  • Formação Superior em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas (Obrigatório)


Competências Comportamentais

•       Liderança Inspiradora: Capacidade de motivar e guiar a equipe para alcançar resultados excepcionais.

•       Habilidade de Negociação: Perfil conciliador e estratégico para negociar com diferentes perfis de clientes, especialmente o produtor rural.

•       Comunicação Clara e Eficaz: Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com clareza com a equipe e clientes.

•       Resolução de Problemas: Aptidão para analisar cenários complexos e propor soluções eficazes e criativas.

•       Inteligência Emocional: Equilíbrio para lidar com situações de pressão e conversas difíceis.

•       Organização e Atenção aos Detalhes: Perfil metódico e preciso para garantir a acuracidade das informações financeiras.


Diferenciais

•       Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria ou Gestão de Negócios.

•       Vivência ou conhecimento do setor do Agronegócio.

•       Experiência com sistemas de CRM.


O que oferecemos

•       Oportunidade de liderar um setor estratégico na maior consultoria de agronegócio do país.

•       Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inovador e com foco em resultados.

•       Plano de carreira e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.

•       Remuneração R$6.000,00 e pacote de benefícios.


Se você é um profissional de finanças apaixonado por desafios e busca uma oportunidade para fazer a diferença em um setor que é o motor do Brasil, venha fazer parte da equipe Pátria AgroNegócios!

description:

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. title: Analyst, Talent Acquisition – Early Careers (LATAM) - Temp. Role
description:
Role Overview

The Talent Acquisition Analyst – Early Careers LATAM will serve as the program management and operational lead supporting early career talent initiatives across key LATAM markets.

This is a temporary position engaged through a third-party partner and integrated into the Early Careers LATAM team to support the execution and continuity of regional programs during a defined program cycle.

The role will coordinate and manage the execution of internship and apprenticeship programs across multiple countries in the region, while also supporting broader Early Careers initiatives including employer branding activations, talent engagement programs, and alumni community initiatives.

Acting as the primary operational point of contact for Early Careers programs, the analyst will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, hiring managers, and external partners to successfully deliver these initiatives across the region.

This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy program management, cross-country coordination, and building impactful early career talent initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

Program Management & Coordination

Act as the PMO and operational owner for Early Careers programs across LATAM markets.

Manage program timelines, recruitment cycles, onboarding activities, and key program milestones.

Coordinate the execution of apprenticeship and internship programs across multiple countries in the region.

Ensure alignment with local regulations, program requirements, and internal processes across markets.

Recruitment Process Coordination

Coordinate recruitment processes for early career roles including internship and apprenticeship positions.

Manage candidate pipelines, interview logistics, and hiring coordination.

Ensure a seamless and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Partner with HR Business Partners and hiring managers to support hiring needs and program planning.

Coordinate with external vendors and partners supporting recruitment, program operations, and training initiatives.

Maintain strong communication and alignment across regional stakeholders.

Program Operations & Governance

Track program progress, key deliverables, and operational timelines across countries.

Maintain program trackers, dashboards, and documentation to support program visibility and governance.

Ensure compliance with program requirements and internal policies.

Early Careers Programs & Initiatives

Support the execution of broader Early Careers initiatives including talent engagement programs, alumni community initiatives, and regional talent experiences.

Assist in coordinating employer branding initiatives connected to early career programs.

Support partnerships with universities, educational institutions, and talent organizations across the region.

Capture insights and learnings from program execution to support continuous improvement of Early Careers initiatives.

Employer Branding & Campus Engagement

Support employer branding activities connected to early career recruitment.

Assist in coordinating university partnerships, recruiting events, and talent engagement initiatives.

Help strengthen the company's presence and reputation among emerging talent across the region.


Basic Qualifications

3–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, HR programs, project coordination, or program management.

Strong project management and organizational skills.

Experience coordinating complex initiatives with multiple stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a regional environment.

Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting campus recruiting or early careers programs.

Experience working with regional teams across multiple countries.

Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and recruitment tools.

Experience coordinating vendors or external partners.

Experience supporting talent programs, employer branding initiatives, or talent engagement projects.


Languages

Portuguese – Fluent

English – Advanced

Spanish – Intermediate/Advanced preferred

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Finance Business Partner to support our rapidly growing Customer Service platform across multiple countries. This role sits at the intersection of finance and operations, acting as a strategic advisor to business leaders while ensuring strong financial governance, scalable processes, and disciplined cost management.


The ideal candidate brings deep Finance BP experience, thrives in fast-paced environments, and demonstrates strong business acumen — particularly within customer-centric or service-driven organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Finance Partnership: Partner closely with the multi-country Customer Service leadership team to drive financial planning, improve decision-making, and embed financial discipline into daily operations.
  • Financial Process Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve financial processes, policies, and controls. Provide expert guidance to support sustainable and compliant business growth.
  • Market Expansion Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries or cities by establishing scalable frameworks, ensuring operational continuity, and proactively mitigating financial risks.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work in close partnership with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls teams to ensure regulatory compliance and alignment with corporate standards.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Leadership: Own the annual budgeting cycle and rolling forecasts for the Customer Experience (CE) business. Build a robust budget management structure and partner with stakeholders to drive accountability and financial performance.
  • Advanced Financial Analysis: Develop a comprehensive financial analysis framework to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver actionable insights — with a strong focus on cost efficiency and operational productivity within customer service environments.
  • Data & Financial Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and digital tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that enhance visibility and decision support.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Proven exposure to multi-country or regional operations .
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to translate financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities and proficiency with financial and data analysis tools.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience managing finance for customer service, contact centers, shared services, or operations-heavy businesses .
  • Background in multinational or high-growth technology, e-commerce, logistics, or platform companies.


Why Join Us

  • Scale with a high-growth global business: Play a key role in supporting rapidly expanding international operations.
  • True business exposure: Operate as a strategic partner with direct impact on operational and financial outcomes.
  • Broad finance scope: Gain hands-on experience across multiple finance disciplines while shaping scalable frameworks for the future.
  • High visibility: Collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence critical business decisions.

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions
